ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 105

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 22

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
